intent_check.summary: G0 is bit-exact (cls(final residual) == native logits, 0.0), so the backward arm has a validated logit-lens. The donor margin +4.65 sits +4.40 nats above the base-rate floor +0.25, so there is a large donor-specific readout to explain, and the coupling +0.99 is carried by a low-rank, causally-read, specific final-residual direction (U_info). The output end of the L3H1->donor-logit graph is anchored.
intent_check.fulfils_prompt_method: The prompt asked to isolate a low-rank clean-corrupt subspace and check that patching only it preserves most recovery -- 'the actual information object you follow through the network.' Done at the final residual: C-Suff patches ONLY U_info and recovers 0.74 (rank-1) / 0.92 (rank-8) of the coupling through the real nonlinear unembed. U_info is that information object, established at the output end.
intent_check.backward_arm_target: U_info = top-SVD of the clean-corrupt final residual. Track ~8 dims (0.76 energy, 0.92 coupling recovery), NOT 1 (0.54 energy, 0.74 recovery): the object is only moderately low-rank (12 dims to 80% energy, 32 to 90%).
intent_check.read_info_alignment: Per-example alignment is STRONG and directly causal: D3 shows the local-linear read g.dh explains 82% of the coupling (corr 0.90), and C-Suff proves U_info is read by the unembed (0.74/0.92 recovery vs random <=0.053, add-one p=0.005 -- ~50x random). The subspace overlap D2 is significant but WEAK (0.15-0.17 vs random 0.002-0.016, ~10-90x): the top-VARIANCE directions of the per-example gradients differ from the top info directions -- an expected nonlinear-head (example-varying LN/GELU Jacobian) effect, NOT the info object going unread. It is far from the random floor, so this is NOT the near-orthogonal case: the program does NOT reframe. The operationally meaningful question -- is the corruption's residual move read by the unembed -- is answered YES by D3 and C-Suff.

checked: SVD-cannot-fail: licensed by controls that can -- C-Null (random rank-k recovers <=0.053, ~50x below observed) and C-Alive (the +4.65 margin collapses to +0.33).

R8 copying/position artifact: guarded -- injecting the no-donor-context baseline collapses the margin to floor (93% of the way), and clean-floor=+4.40 confirms a real donor-specific readout above base-rate rather than a constant G-bias.

R10 conditional inflation: avoided -- unconditional set (min_effect=None) + ratio-of-means; the measured coupling +0.990 matches the known unconditional val coupling (~0.973), confirming no outcome-conditioning crept in.
too-clean tell (R7): none -- no two conditions agree to many significant figures; observed recovery and its null are ~50x apart, not an algebraic identity.
escaped_failure_modes.residual_risk: C-Alive passes with a thin point-estimate margin (alive +0.334 vs threshold +0.347). The +0.087 excess over the floor is head nonlinearity: margin(mean residual) != mean(margin) (Jensen gap). The substantive collapse (+4.65 -> +0.33, 93% toward floor) is unambiguous, but the single-baseline point estimate sits near the tolerance edge; a per-example baseline would remove the gap at the cost of equalling the floor by construction.
